source: Spec #639 'Basket v1' and 'Materiality and grading'; owner decisions 2026-11-25 on #477 (Q1 thresholds, Q3 CBOT exact) and #479 (tolerances live here); per-stratum values from research/2026-11-25-accuracy-v4-v6-proposals.md section 1.2 and 1.4 (PR #619).
rules: A delta is material when it exceeds the native tolerance AND the economic threshold. A metadata fail (date, contract, window, grade, incoterm, unit, FX date) is material at any delta.

kind exact: same definition; tolerance = the publisher's rounding plus our display and conversion rounding. kind band: different definition, compared inside a stated explained band. kind recompute: Tier 3 arithmetic from the displayed legs.
A record stamps the tolerance_version it was graded under. Past records are never re-graded. Each change is a 'Tolerance changes' ledger row; loosening needs measured evidence, not a failing sample.
economic_thresholds_note: Each stratum's threshold_usd_mt is the one a grade reads: a number for every leg, or a table keyed by product (bean, meal, oil) with an optional default. A product the table neither names nor defaults is refused. Owner, 2026-11-25 (#477 Q1): 0.5 USD/MT for bean-scale and every derived number, 1.5 for oil legs. Pre-buyer numbers, open to revision in the A12 session (#406).
leg_products_note: A leg's product is read from its displayed label: it must contain the words of exactly one product. A label naming none, or two, is refused (owner 2026-11-26, #663).
